name: tweet
title: X post
description: An X-style text post card with author, handle, verification, replies, and likes.

vanillasky.useWhen: A grounded public announcement, founder update, launch quote, or concise social claim should read as a post.

authorName.title: Author name
authorName.description: Display name shown bold next to the verified checkmark.

authorHandle.title: Handle
authorHandle.description: Username in @format. Leave empty to auto-derive from author name (e.g. 'Linear' → '@linear').

authorVerified.title: Verified checkmark
authorVerified.description: Show the blue verified checkmark next to the author name.

message.title: Tweet text
message.description: The tweet/post content. Reads best at 1-3 lines (~80-180 chars). Emoji land naturally at the end of a phrase.

mediaUrl.title: Background media
mediaUrl.description: Optional photo or video URL behind this scene. When set, replaces the brand gradient.

mediaKeyword.title: Background search keyword
mediaKeyword.description: 2-4 word English term for Pexels stock-footage search (auto-fills mediaUrl).

mediaType.title: Background media type
mediaType.description: auto detects photo/video from URL. 'gradient' is a deliberate mode — atmospheric brand-color scene with no stock footage.

mediaPoster.title: Background poster image
mediaPoster.description: Still image URL shown while a video backdrop is decoding its first frame. Auto-filled from Pexels' thumbnail when fillPexelsUrls sets a video mediaUrl. Hides the gradient flash that would otherwise appear in the ~50–400ms gap between a <video> mounting and decoding its first frame.

mediaPosition.title: Background focal position
mediaPosition.description: Controls which part of a photo or video stays visible when cover-cropped. Pick the subject's side or vertical anchor after inspecting the frame.

mediaTreatment.title: Background contrast treatment
mediaTreatment.description: subtle preserves a visual hero; cinematic adds balanced contrast; text-safe adds a stronger wash for copy-heavy scenes.

vanillasky.label: X post
vanillasky.description: An X-style text post card with author, handle, verification, replies, and likes.
vanillasky.avoidWhen: The copy is generic explanatory prose, attribution is missing, or visual attachments are essential.
